  PROBLEM: Hot-file paths are not normalized in a way that matches canonical merge-tree paths.
  WHY: Both reviewers say paths with whitespace, backslashes, or leading `./` can miss the hot-file short-circuit; other reviewers said this normalization is already fixed.

  WHY: The reviewer says human replies that quote the marker are stripped from the hash, so new guidance can be ignored until replay limits kick in.

  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
